trust_decision.summary: Function source text (String(fn), which can be attacker-shaped when the function was built from untrusted code) is parsed with backtracking-prone regexes; the protection is that parsing a function's source must take linear time. It is decided in function#toStringTokens (and, before the pin, function#copy).

landing_point.why: The summary names function#copy and function#toStringTokens. copy.js has no regex left at the pin (function/#/copy.js:3-19), so the only remaining regexes are re1/re2 in to-string-tokens.js.

fix_sites.entry_point: fn.copy() via function/#/index.js; ALREADY FIXED at the pinned commit (the pin equals fix commit 3551cdd, fix.diff:1-34)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route exists. The other function-source regex, object/is-plain-function.js:3, is anchored and linear, and the other regexes in the tree (string/#/indent.js:6, reg-exp/#/is-sticky.js:4, reg-exp/#/is-unicode.js:4, function/is-function.js:4) do not have the nested or overlapping quantifier shape.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: toStringTokens must still split args/body for classic functions, arrow functions with or without parentheses, expression and block bodies, and ES2015 default parameters that contain nested parens/braces/arrows; it must reject class strings. A fix that just rejects or truncates hard input breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: arrow function without parens, e.g. foo=>bar (fix.diff:77-86,142)
default params with nested arrow/object literal (fix.diff:143-146)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a function-source classifier (e.g. detecting arrow/async/generator source) built with a similar [\0-\uffff]* alternation regex over fnToString output
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the module already pattern-matches Function.prototype.toString output, and a maintainer extending it to more function kinds would plausibly reuse the to-string-tokens regex idiom

O8b_injection_room.sibling: function serialisation that normalises or extracts the function signature with a regex over String(fn)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: serialize/unserialize already round-trip function source (test/object/serialize.js:11, test/object/unserialize.js:10); this would add a save/reload-type sibling, but it is planted and WHERE-type, so it counts as an extra only

O10_build.project_tests: test/function/#/to-string-tokens.js (tad); the fix adds an esniff dependency (fix.diff:117), and node_modules is not present in the pinned tree

j.j_sites_touched: function/#/to-string-tokens.js (function/#/copy.js already fixed at the pin)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Tighten re1/re2 (or add a length cap) instead of replacing the regexes with a linear scanner; this either stays super-linear or breaks default-param/nested-arrow parsing.

out_of_scope_notes: parent_commit equals fix commit 3551cdd, so the pinned tree already contains the function#copy fix (function/#/copy.js:6-19); a correct pin would be 3551cdd^ (7855319).
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell); es5-ext is a small utility library and is very likely under 5 MB, so tiny_repo probably applies but was not confirmed.
Not checked whether npm dependencies (tad, esniff) are cached for offline builds; node_modules is absent in the pinned tree.
The linear-time claims for the other regexes come from reading the patterns, not from execution.
